开启后，群安静一段时间，她会有机会主动醒来参与。仍受能力总开关和省电策略影响。: After turning it on, the group will be quiet for a period of time, and she will have the opportunity to wake up and participate. Still affected by the capacity master switch and power saving strategy.
冷场时主动参与的基础概率。0.2 表示 20%。调高更容易获得主动发言机会；实际: The basic probability of active participation in the cold game. 0.2 means 20%. Turning it up makes it easier to get the opportunity to speak actively; in fact, it will also be affected by night time, recent activity level, etc., and you may choose not to speak after waking up.
群里连续多久没有新消息，才算冷场。调小会更早给她主动参与的机会。单位：分钟。: How long has there been no new news in the group before it becomes quiet? Turning it down will give her an earlier chance to actively participate. Unit: minutes.
主动机会检查间隔的下限。间隔从上下限中随机取值；越短检查越频繁，但不代表每次都会: The active machine checks the lower bound of the interval. The interval is randomly selected from the upper and lower limits; the shorter the interval, the more frequent the check, but it does not mean that it will speak every time. Unit: minutes.
主动机会检查间隔的上限。与左侧下限一起决定随机检查的频率。单位：分钟。: The active machine checks the upper limit of the interval. Together with the left lower bound, determines the frequency of random checks. Unit: minutes.
允许二代仿真运行。实际参与聊天还取决于当前运行模式、白名单和能力总开关。: Allow second-generation simulations to run. Actual participation in the chat also depends on the current operating mode, whitelist, and ability master switches.
二代仿真使用的 DSH 预设名称。它决定加载哪套智能体规则；需与已安装的预设名称: DSH preset name used by second generation emulation. It determines which set of agent rules to load; it must match the name of the installed preset.
开启后把下面的推荐值告诉 AI；这些值是建议。硬限制仍由桥接强制执行。: After turning it on, tell the AI ​​the following recommended values; these values ​​are suggestions. Hard limits are still enforced by the bridge.
普通消息唤醒的推荐概率，0.05 表示 5%。它是给 AI 的建议，AI 可以另: The recommended probability of awakening by ordinary messages, 0.05 means 5%. It is a suggestion to the AI, which can set its own wake-up conditions.
推荐潜水时长的下限。调大建议她更久不参与；它是建议，和下面的硬限制不同。单位：分: The lower limit of recommended dive duration. Turning it up suggests that she stay away for longer; it's a suggestion, not the same as a hard limit below. Unit: minutes.
推荐潜水时长的上限。AI 可以选择别的时长，但仍受唤醒硬限制约束。单位：分钟。: Recommended maximum dive duration. The AI ​​can choose another duration, but is still subject to the hard limit of wakeup. Unit: minutes.
默认不设定时唤醒；仍可能按已启用的关键词、点名等事件唤醒。: It is not set to wake up by default; it may still wake up according to enabled keywords, roll call and other events.
建议在这些词出现时醒来看看。用逗号分隔；只有普通概率与关键词的配置口径不同，不要: It is recommended to wake up and read when these words appear. Separate with commas; only the common probability is different from the keyword configuration caliber, do not confuse it with a guaranteed return promise.
最短潜水时间。硬限制由桥接执行；输入单位是秒，保存时自动转为毫秒。: Minimum dive time. The hard limit is enforced by the bridge; the input unit is seconds and is automatically converted to milliseconds when saving.
限制单次潜水最长时间。0 表示不设上限；输入单位是秒。: Limit the maximum duration of a single dive. 0 means no upper limit; the input unit is seconds.
一分钟内最多允许唤醒多少次，避免过于频繁触发。0 表示不限制。: The maximum number of wake-ups allowed in one minute to avoid triggering too frequently. 0 means no limit.
一小时内最多允许唤醒多少次。调低更克制，也可能延后参与。0 表示不限制。: The maximum number of wake-ups allowed within an hour. Turning it down is more restrained and may delay participation. 0 means no limit.
把短时间内的新消息合并处理。调大可减少频繁唤醒，但参与会稍晚。单位：毫秒。: Combine and process new messages within a short period of time. Turning it up reduces frequent arousals, but engagement is later. Unit: milliseconds.
进入潜水前先观察这么久，给群友留出回复时间。0 表示不限制。单位：分钟。: Observe for this long before entering the dive to give the group members time to reply. 0 means no limit. Unit: minutes.
要求 AI 在沉睡前先等待观察，避免刚说完话就立刻潜水。: Ask the AI ​​to wait and observe before falling asleep to avoid diving immediately after speaking.
AI 被唤醒后连续没有行动时，桥接触发兜底的次数门槛。: When the AI ​​takes no action continuously after being awakened, the threshold for the number of times the AI ​​triggers the bottom is bridged.
AI 没有设置收尾唤醒条件时，最多提醒它几次。: When the AI ​​does not set the final wake-up condition, it will be reminded at most a few times.
允许一轮回复拆成多条。二代需要 AI 显式传数组或调用分条工具，不按空格自动拆分: Allow one round of replies to be split into multiple pieces. The second generation requires AI to explicitly pass the array or call the striping tool, and does not automatically split according to spaces.
一次分条回复最多发几条。调低可以减少连续刷屏。: The maximum number of replies you can send at one time is in multiple pieces. Turning it down can reduce continuous screen refresh.
两条消息间的随机等待下限。调大更像慢慢打字，发送也会更慢。单位：毫秒。: The lower bound of random wait between two messages. Turning it up is more like typing slowly, and sending will be slower. Unit: milliseconds.
两条消息间的随机等待上限。与下限一起决定分条节奏。单位：毫秒。: The upper limit of random waits between two messages. Together with the lower limit, it determines the striping rhythm. Unit: milliseconds.
偶尔使用更长发送间隔的概率。0.1 表示 10%，调高会更常停顿。: Probability to occasionally use longer sending intervals. 0.1 means 10%, turning it up will cause more frequent pauses.
每分钟发送条数上限。调低减少刷屏；0 表示不限制。: The maximum number of messages sent per minute. Turn it down to reduce screen swiping; 0 means no limit.
每小时发送条数上限。0 表示不限制，调低可能使发送被限流。: The maximum number of messages sent per hour. 0 means no limit, lowering it may cause the sending rate to be limited.
每条消息允许的最大字符数，避免单条回复过长。: The maximum number of characters allowed per message to avoid making a single reply too long.
发送间隔的硬上限，避免停顿过久。单位：毫秒。: A hard upper limit on the sending interval to avoid long pauses. Unit: milliseconds.
按字数计算发送间隔时使用的基础等待时间。单位：毫秒。: The base wait time used when calculating send intervals by word count. Unit: milliseconds.
每多一个字追加多少发送等待时间。调高会使长消息发得更慢。单位：毫秒。: How much sending waiting time is added for each additional word. Increasing the value will cause long messages to be sent more slowly. Unit: milliseconds.
等待新消息工具的默认超时时长。没有新消息时，等到这里才返回。单位：毫秒。: The default timeout for the tool to wait for new messages. When there is no new message, wait until here before returning. Unit: milliseconds.
新消息后等待一段安静时间，减少在别人还没说完时抢话。单位：毫秒。: Wait for a period of quiet time after new messages to reduce talking before others have finished speaking. Unit: milliseconds.
收到新消息后，最少再等多久才返回。调高更耐心，也会稍慢。单位：毫秒。: After receiving a new message, the minimum amount of time to wait before returning. Turning it up is more patient and a little slower. Unit: milliseconds.
发言后隔多久回来检查有没有人回复。调小检查更及时，但可能增加调用。单位：秒。: Check back after a while to see if anyone has responded. Turning the check down is more timely, but may increase calls. Unit: seconds.
把收到的 QQ 语音转成文字，供她理解。需要同时启用「听懂语音」能力总开关。: Convert the received QQ voice into text for her to understand. The "Understand Speech" ability master switch needs to be enabled at the same time.
SenseVoice 在本地识别并可标注语气；QQ 转写使用 QQ 能力；关闭则: SenseVoice recognizes and can mark tone locally; QQ transcribe uses QQ capabilities; if it is turned off, it will not transcribe.
启动桥接时就加载模型，首条语音更快；也会更早占用内存。: If the model is loaded when bridging is started, the first voice message will be faster; it will also occupy memory earlier.
连续闲置这么久后释放模型内存，下次用到再加载。0 表示一直常驻。单位：分钟。: Release the model memory after being idle for so long, and load it again next time it is used. 0 means always resident. Unit: minutes.
本地识别使用的 CPU 线程数。更多线程可能更快，也会增加资源占用。: Number of CPU threads used by local recognition. More threads may be faster, but also increase resource usage.
同时处理的语音数。调高可减少排队，也会增加资源消耗。: Number of voices processed simultaneously. Increasing it can reduce queuing and increase resource consumption.
每条语音最多转写多少秒；超长音频会受此限制。: The maximum number of seconds for each voice to be transcribed; very long audio will be subject to this limit.
单条识别最多等待多少秒，避免识别任务长期卡住。: The maximum number of seconds to wait for a single identification to avoid the identification task being stuck for a long time.
在转写结果中附带识别到的情绪，帮助 AI 理解语气；结果可能有误。: Recognized emotions are included in the transcription results to help the AI ​​understand the tone; the results may be incorrect.
在转写中标注笑声、掌声等声学事件。: Annotate acoustic events such as laughter, applause, etc. in your transcription.
本地识别失败时尝试 QQ 自带转写，提高可用性。: When local recognition fails, try QQ's own transliteration to improve usability.
指定语音识别语言；自动适合多种语言混用，明确语言可减少歧义。: Specify the speech recognition language; automatically adapt to the mixing of multiple languages, and clear language can reduce ambiguity.
整理转写中的标点、数字等书面格式，提高可读性。: Organize punctuation, numbers and other written formats in the transcription to improve readability.
最多缓存多少条转写结果。调大可减少重复识别，也会多占内存。: The maximum number of transcription results to be cached. Increasing the size can reduce duplicate recognition and will also occupy more memory.
允许 AI 把文字合成语音。还需要开启「开口说话」总开关和合成语音工具权限。: Allows AI to synthesize text into speech. You also need to turn on the "Speak" master switch and the permissions for the synthesized voice tool.
选择负责把文字变成声音的服务。切换只展示该服务的参数；请确认地址、音色和凭证。: Choose a service that turns text into sound. Toggle shows only parameters for that service; please confirm address, timbre, and credentials.
一天最多合成多少字符，帮助控制费用。0 表示不限制。: How many characters can be synthesized at most in one day to help control costs. 0 means no limit.
裁掉语音开头和结尾的静音，让语音条更紧凑。: Trim the silence at the beginning and end of the voice to make the voice bar more compact.
允许 AI 在合成时指定情绪；实际效果取决于服务商是否支持。: Allows AI to specify emotions when compositing; actual effect depends on service provider support.
把符合长度要求的文字短句按概率换成语音条。不是每条回复都变成语音。: Short text sentences that meet the length requirements are replaced with voice strips based on probability. Not every reply will be voiced.
普通短句转成语音的概率。填 5 表示 5%，调高会更常听到她说话。: The probability of converting ordinary short sentences into speech. Enter 5 for 5%, and turn it up to hear her more often.
对方刚发过语音时，使用这个转换概率。调高更容易以语音回应语音。: When the other party has just sent a voice message, this conversion probability is used. Turn it up to make it easier to respond to speech with your voice.
同一会话两次随机转语音之间至少等多久，避免连续语音刷屏。单位：分钟。: The minimum amount of time to wait between two random voice changes in the same conversation to avoid continuous voice swiping. Unit: minutes.
随机转换只在私聊生效，群聊仍以文字为主。: Random conversion only takes effect in private chats, group chats are still text-based.
允许发送音频库中已有的文件；这与把文字合成语音是两种能力。: Allows sending files that are already in the audio library; this is the same ability as synthesizing text into speech.
发送后自动读取回执，帮助确认 QQ 侧的语音发送结果。: Automatically read the receipt after sending to help confirm the voice sending result on the QQ side.
启用收藏表情的同步、备注和发送；仍受能力总开关与工具权限影响。: Enable synchronization, notes and sending of favorite emoticons; still affected by the ability master switch and tool permissions.
AI 决定发表情后，再按这个概率放行。填 30 表示 30%，100 表示每次都: After the AI ​​decides to send an expression, it will be released based on this probability. Enter 30 for 30% and 100 for pass every time.
收藏表情列表缓存多久。调小更新更及时，但会更频繁查询 QQ。单位：秒。: How long is the favorite emoticon list cached. Turning it down will make updates more timely, but will query QQ more frequently. Unit: seconds.
向 AI 主动展示多少个常用表情。更多选择会增加上下文消耗。: How many common expressions are actively displayed to the AI. More choices increase context consumption.
主动把表情摘要放进上下文。关闭后仍可通过工具查找表情。: Proactively put emoticon summaries into context. After closing, you can still find emoticons through the tool.
允许 AI 收藏群友发来的表情，仍受收藏频率限制。: Allowing AI to collect emoticons sent by group friends is still subject to collection frequency restrictions.
文字回复满足字数或情绪条件时，提醒 AI 可以补一张表情；不会保证一定发送。: When the text reply meets the word count or emotion conditions, the AI ​​will be reminded to add an emoticon; it will not be guaranteed to be sent.
读取最近聊天记录时最多返回多少条。调高可以看到更多历史，也会增加上下文消耗。: The maximum number of records returned when reading recent chat records. Increasing the value allows you to see more history and also increases context consumption.
一次最多返回多少条未读消息。调高可覆盖更多未读，也会增加上下文消耗。: The maximum number of unread messages returned at one time. Increasing it can cover more unreads and also increase context consumption.
附带给 AI 的聊天上下文条数。调高有助于连贯理解，也会增加 token 消耗。: The number of chat contexts attached to the AI. Increasing the value helps coherent understanding, but also increases token consumption.
一代仿真在满足冷场条件后主动开话题的成功概率。0.2 表示 20%，调高更容易开: The success probability of a first-generation simulation taking the initiative to open a topic after meeting the cold field conditions. 0.2 means 20%, and turning it up makes it easier to speak.
观望期遇到普通消息时进入活跃的概率。调高会更积极参与一代群聊。: The probability of becoming active when encountering ordinary news during the wait-and-see period. Turning it up will result in more active participation in generation group chats.
普通消息选择不回复的概率。调高会更安静，仅作用于一代仿真。: The probability of choosing not to reply to an ordinary message. Turning it up will make it quieter, and only affects one generation of emulation.
发生抬杠时选择退让的概率。调高更少继续争论，仅作用于一代仿真。: The probability of choosing to give in when a dispute occurs. Turn up less to continue the argument, only for one generation of emulation.
每次最多注入多少角色文本。调高可保留更多设定，也会增加上下文用量。: The maximum amount of character text to inject each time. Turning it higher preserves more settings and increases context usage.
离电时暂停主动冒泡，减少后台唤醒。插电后按原策略恢复。: Pause active bubbling when powered off to reduce background wake-up. After plugging in, restore according to the original strategy.
离电时按此页选择的能力执行省电策略。文字核心聊天始终可用。: When powering off, the power saving strategy is executed according to the capabilities selected on this page. Text core chat is always available.
离电时临时降低或调整思考强度，插电后恢复已配置档位。: Temporarily reduce or adjust the thinking intensity when powering off, and restore the configured gear after plugging in.
服务访问凭证。留空保持已保存的值；控制台不会回显完整凭证。: Service access credentials. Leave blank to retain the saved value; the console will not echo the full credentials.
从该环境变量读取凭证，减少把密钥直接写进配置文件的需要。: Reading the credentials from this environment variable reduces the need to write the keys directly into the configuration file.
服务的请求地址。修改后会连接到这个服务；请与所选引擎或服务商的地址对应。: The request address of the service. After modification, you will be connected to this service; please correspond to the address of the selected engine or service provider.
等待这项操作完成的最长时间。调大更能容忍慢任务，也会在失败时等待更久。: The maximum time to wait for this operation to complete. Scaling it up is more tolerant of slow tasks and will wait longer on failure.
请按字段标注的单位填写。: Please fill in the unit marked in the field.
